# StarlingPost

StarlingPost is a social media scheduling and automation tool that publishes a single post to YouTube, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn — with Instagram, Facebook, and Threads coming soon.

## What it does

- Write one caption, publish to multiple platforms simultaneously
- AI caption enhancement via OpenAI gpt-4o-mini (per-platform tone, length, hashtags)
- Post scheduling: set a time, StarlingPost publishes automatically via Vercel cron
- Link Me: keyword-triggered auto-reply (someone comments "link" → they receive your link automatically)
- Auto Reply: template or AI-generated contextual replies to comments, with dedup tracking
- Analytics: views, likes, comments, reach across connected platforms

## Live platforms (beta)

- YouTube
- Twitter/X
- LinkedIn

## Coming soon

- Instagram
- Facebook
- Threads

## Pricing (14-day free trial on all plans, no credit card required)

- Starter: $9/month — 3 connected accounts, 30 posts/month, 3 automation rules
- Growth: $19/month — 10 connected accounts, unlimited posts, live analytics, optimal timing AI
- Agency: $49/month — unlimited accounts, multiple workspaces, team seats, API access

No free tier.

## Tech stack

- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5
- Auth & database: Firebase Auth + Firestore
- AI: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini
- Hosting: Vercel (with scheduled cron jobs)
- Social APIs: Twitter API v2, YouTube Data API v3, LinkedIn API
